image_description: A close-up shot of a baby wearing a black bib with white trim. The bib features two distinct printed graphics: a yellow/green textured figure on the left and a photorealistic face of a person wearing a crown on the right. The baby is holding the straps of the bib near their neck. The background is a plain white sheet or fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The print of the crowned face has an uncanny, slightly melted quality typical of AI-generated textures, lacking the crisp halftone dots of real printing.
The fingers holding the bib straps are indistinct and blob-like, lacking clear joint definition and nail details, suggesting generation artifacts.
The text on the left strap is gibberish and warps unnaturally, a common artifact in AI images attempting to render small text.
